subject.title: Plugin UI: add scoped action bridge for sandboxed tabs

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `sessionActions` and `allowChatNavigation` as supported Plugin SDK and Gateway protocol capabilities for sandboxed external tabs?
rationale: This is an additive public plugin and protocol contract with security-boundary implications; code review cannot choose its long-term owner, compatibility promise, or supported use cases.

options.title: Approve the narrow bridge contract
options.body: Keep the descriptor-scoped allowlist and independent navigation capability, but require Gateway-owned context derivation and explicit compatibility coverage before merge.

options.title: Defer public capability expansion
options.body: Keep the existing read-only sandbox-tab boundary and move mutation/navigation requirements to an owner-approved design or plugin API proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow bridge contract
recommendation.body: Keep the descriptor-scoped allowlist and independent navigation capability, but require Gateway-owned context derivation and explicit compatibility coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current gateway-auth sandbox-tab boundary that this PR extends.
